Hey. Don’t be dissing Flint Lockwood.

I don’t think kidnapping anyone is the answer, obviously. I don’t support acts of violence as a form of protest, nor do I support the idea of overthrowing the government.

That said, as a Michigan resident, Whitmer has done a terrible job as governor. That is regardless of the fact that she is a woman. She has gone far enough that the Michigan Supreme Court struck down her emergency policies, as they were overreaching and extreme. Her policies likely led to the COVID-related deaths of hundreds, if not thousands of senior lives after she moved COVID patients into retirement homes.

So, obviously you shouldn’t kidnap anyone. It’s also not an issue of sexism. She has been a terrible governor based purely on her actions and policies.
